The bill retrospectively repeals paragraph 5(e) of the Superannuation (Salary) Regulations from 1 July 1986 to regularise the long-standing practice of not including rent-free housing in superannuation salary, except for a limited cohort where contributions were made on that basis between 1 July 1986 and 28 February 2022.

The opposition supported the Public Sector Superannuation Salary Legislation Amendment Bill 2022, which retrospectively clarifies that rent-free housing for diplomats does not count as salary for superannuation, addressing the Peace case and avoiding a potential $8–11 billion budget impact.
